name: Harkoi
summary: Lumbering six-legged behemoths of black ever-frost whose white eyes betray a deep wisdom. Harkoi know the laws of the earth, and keep the laws of Kings in their frigid hearts. Their arctic objectivity is often relied upon in disputes of state.
effects:
Innate| Foundation: You are immune to Frost Damage and Extreme Cold. Likewise, when you suffer any Energy Damage, you can spend Light for 0_AP to make it less Vicious, eventually even Blunting it.
Active| White Rime: Touch a Weapon for 1_AP, you make it more Vicious and capable of dealing Frost Damage for T Minutes. Doing the same to Armor or a Shield makes it more durable and grants its bearer Resistance to Energy Damage for T Minutes.
Active| Ice Bind: For 1_AP, you conjure Chains between two Targets within 10 Meters, Linking them at their current distance. Your Chains are forged from black eternal ice and have 2T Durability, Resistance:2_All(except Incendiary), and are Immune to Blunted Damage. While any of your Chains are within 100 Meters, you may increase or decrease their length by up to 3 Meters per AP spent.

attrs.bond: Law is the foundations of earth and vaults of the Sea. The Law by which you are Bound is essential to Binding Harkoi.

name: Howrung
summary: Untamed beasts of wing and claw, eyes burning a voltaic, brilliant blue-white, voices crashing with thunder and joy. An enormous flock of them were released when the Southern Storm wall fell, leading to an increase of tropic storms in following years.
effects:
Innate| Wind Roar: At any time, you can Invoke a Cyclone (no Light required.) This is a Radius centered on you up to 6(Your Tier.) Ranged Attacks are deflected off this boundary (unless they deal more Damage than its Radius) and Enemies treat it as Difficult Terrain up to your Tier. Leaving the Radius of your Cyclone inflicts Frost Damage.
Active| Flash and Bang: You instantly Maneuver up to 3T Meters in a straight line (any direction), everything between you and your destination suffers Voltaic Damage. This allows you to pass through Creatures and Objects with a Durability lower than your Reflex.
Passive| Atlas Aspect: You innately know the Weather in your currently locale in advance, within T Days. During a natural Storm, you gain a Flying Speed equal to twice your Movement, your Cyclone negates all Enemy Ranged Attacks, and you are immune to Voltaic Damage entirely; when hit by Voltaic Damage, you may re-direct it within 10T Meters. When Lightning would strike, you can force it to target you.

attrs.bond: By their nature, Howrung revel in the whirlwind, compelling you to seek out peril and disorder. Fully denying this compulsion Frustrates your Bond.

name: Oolupsil
summary: Rising from the earth, light and seemingly made of shifting fronds, Oolupsil give the impression of being a part of something much larger. Part of networks spanning kilometers under the forest floor, Spirit and fungal body entwined, this impression is more than correct.
effects:
Innate| Proliferation: When you Touch a Creature, you can implant a Spore (and no more than one). Spores remain for Days equal to your Training in Spirit Binding, and you have an intuitive sense of where they are, and which Creature they belong to. Likewise, you know the general condition of a Spored Creature, their emotional state, and health. You can use First-Aid on a Spored Creature, regardless of Distance, or spend 1_AP to make them Off-Balance for one Round. Finally Spored Creatures can be treated as your own Space for Invoking Powers.
Active| Rooting: You conjure up to T Spaces full of Mushrooms within 10 Meters. They have 3 Durability and are edible, having any flavor you like, but no nutritional value. Additional Light can be Spent to increase the Durability of the product by 3 per. If allowed to remain and consume substrate, they gain nutritional value after about a Month of cultivation. The properties of these as Ingredients follows from their substrate, something to be discovered through experimentation.
Active| Mycelia: Invoked at thrice a Target's Tier, you leave a Tiny Permanent Spore with a Touch. As a Magical Effect, these are vulnerable to certain forms of Negation, but otherwise do not require additional effort to sustain.
